caption: The drawing depicts a lidded, two-handled vessel resembling a trophy or a covered cup, centrally positioned on a plain background. The vessel has a rounded body with a slightly flaring rim, two symmetrical angular handles extending from each side, and a domed lid topped with a small ornamental finial. The base is rounded and slightly elevated. The object is rendered in shades of grey, with areas of subtle blue tone to suggest reflected light and metallic sheen. The texture and shading indicate a reflective surface, typical of metal. In the upper left corner, there is a monogram or stylized inscription in cursive, composed of interwoven letters. The drawing is executed on off-white or lightly yellowed paper, and the object casts a faint shadow beneath it.
title: Silver Sugar Bowl
